reason_current_run_is_not_interpolated: The current full-season source is contiguous and has zero core missing values; strict validation preserves the observed source without unnecessary reconstruction.

recommended_profile_if_a_gap_occurs.precipitation_treatment: preserve source precipitation and apply explicit PSUM accumulation/resampling; do not linearly invent precipitation
recommended_profile_if_a_gap_occurs.phase_treatment: derive PSUM_PH only after the temperature and precipitation contract is satisfied
recommended_profile_if_a_gap_occurs.snow_depth_treatment: source QA only; do not fill or assimilate as HS

abort_before_native_run_when: any unresolved core field gap remains
any leading or trailing gap would require extrapolation
any internal gap exceeds the provisional one-hour missing-duration profile
any precipitation, phase, or snow-depth value would be invented or filled
field-level fill counts cannot be reproduced from the input-quality report
failure_threshold.customer_numeric_approval_required_befor: enabling interpolation in a future run or changing the provisional profile

required_reporting.counts: per-field interpolated values, per-field unresolved values, total fills, and maximum observed gap
required_reporting.evidence: source timeline, corrected timeline, policy version, algorithm, gap locations, and resulting manifest hash
